pass_b_english: An enumeration of seventy-two prophets and prophetesses. Concerning the Old Testament prophets and prophetesses, Epiphanius. 1. Adam. 2. Enoch. 3. Noah. 4. Abraham. 5. Isaac. 6. Jacob. 7. Moses. 8. Aaron. 9. Joshua. 10. Eldam. 11. Mordad. 12. Job. 13. Samuel. 14. Nathan. 15. David. 16. Gad. 17. Ithidoum. 18. Asaph. 19. Aiman. 20. Aitham. 21. Solomon. 22. Achias. 23. Semeas. 24. The man of God, Seth. 25. Eli, and also Shillum. 26. Joad. 27. Addow. 28. Azarias. 29. Anani, and also Ananias. 30. Jehu. 31. Michaias. 32. Elias. 33. Oziel. 34. Eliad. 35. Jesus, son of Ananius. 36. Elisha. 37. Jonathan.
